title: Felt-Light Mornings
description: A dreamy, melody-led garage-house slow burn: a felt-piano chord motif and a chopped, pitch-shifted vocal hook drift over a swung 2-step groove and a sidechained pad that breathes with the kick. It builds patiently from a hazy intro into a warm, communal peak, then dissolves into tape-reverb and delay.
